title: Runtime-validar la UI de Super Admin en el entorno aplicable

failure.reason: Browser reached authenticated UGO TEST Super Admin shell, but Playwright exact accessible-name selector for 'Super Admin' timed out because rendered button includes the leading icon glyph.
failure.next_safe_fix: Use a non-exact accessible-name selector (for example /Super Admin/) and rerun only after scheduler policy permits a new attempt.

remaining_verifiable_steps: Correct the Playwright Super Admin navigation selector without changing product behavior.
Run UGO Super Admin UI Runtime TEST on one exact SHA and complete Autonomy, QA, Model Router, Risk/Audit, Timeline and Launch Gate checks.
Require Judge PASS then Sentinel PASS and persist immutable runtime artifacts for that same SHA.
